name: flux
description: A complete, harness-neutral work cycle for Git repositories: probe, refine, issue, build, peek, review, iterate, land, and reply, plus map and equip, which prepare the machine and the repository.

interface.longDescription: Flux is a shared family of eleven workflows that carries work from production telemetry to refinement, issue, code, quick look, review, iteration, landing, and reply, plus map and equip, which sit outside the cycle: map surveys the installation on your machine and dispatches the repairs you accept, equip prepares a repository. Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex use the same skills, agents, and contracts through native harness adapters.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request with Flux.
Turn this idea into a well-grounded issue.
Iterate on this PR until its checks settle.
